caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a wooden spoon with a broad, flat, rounded bowl and a short, thick, upward-curving handle. The spoon is rendered in shades of brown, with visible wood grain patterns and a dark crack running near the bottom of the bowl. The background is plain and uncolored, providing a neutral backdrop that highlights the object. The drawing is centered on the page with the handle oriented diagonally upward to the right. Beneath the spoon, the artist's name, "Alexander Anderson," and the year "1839" are written in small capital letters.
title: Butter Ladle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
